title: Office Work
description: One clear view of assignments, progress, and deadlines.
myDescription: Your assigned work, progress, and upcoming deadlines.
creator: Creator
eligibleHint: Only active accounts you can assign work to are listed.
unfinishedHighNote: Show high-priority tasks that still need attention.
archiveNote: Archived tasks are read-only and excluded from dashboard counts.
completionNote: Completed tasks / total active tasks in this view
totalHint: Show all tasks in this view
workloadDescription: Counts reflect the same search and filters as the dashboard.
emptyEmployeeDescription: Tasks assigned to you will appear here. Check back when your team assigns new work.
emptyManagementDescription: Create a task to give your team a clear next step.
noMatchesDescription: Try changing the search or filters to find more work.
overrideReason: Reason for acting on behalf of the assignee
reassignWarning: Changing the assignee resets this task to Pending and clears its start and completion timestamps. Its previous history is preserved.
reassignPendingText: The new assignee will be responsible for this task.
archiveDescription: The task and its history will be preserved. Archived tasks are read-only.
reasonHint: Explain the change for the activity history.
conflict: This task changed or the result could not be confirmed. Refresh the current task before trying again.
taskUnavailable: This task is unavailable or you no longer have access.
error: Unable to load office work. Please retry.
actionFailed: The task could not be updated. Check the form and refresh before trying again.
invalidRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.
listDescription: Open a task to see its details and activity.
overrideNote: An administrative reason is required when changing another person’s task status.
dueDateHint: Date only, using the business timezone.
lookupsFailed: Unable to load people. Retry to continue.
assigneeInvalid: This person is no longer eligible for assignment. Refresh and select an active assignee.
validationFailed: Check the task fields and try again.
emptyPageDescription: The list changed or this page is beyond the last result. Return to the first page.
assigneeEditHint: Use Reassign to change the assignee.
workUpdateHint: Share progress, results, or handover notes. Saved updates appear in the activity history.
